title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: The strongest radio leads for 13–19 October are NET FM on FM 101 MHz (recurring weekend sports slots and a Friday 18:30 slot titled ‘Mhux Premier biss’), plus DAB+ directory listings for Radio Sportiva and BBC World Service. WorldDAB lists BBC World Service on Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz and a service named ‘Sports Channel’ on block 12A whose identity is unverified. Reception at the hotel and event venue remains untested. No radio carriage of the Thunderpick Finals, the Gżira United–Mosta match on 14 October, a Premier League match, or the Rolex Middle Sea Race has been verified. The Premier League’s own live-audio page is an internet stream, not over-the-air radio.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring weekly grid lists Hits & Score on Saturday at 16:00 and Sports Box on Sunday at 15:00 (times as published by the Malta station; timezone not explicitly stated). In this trip window those days are 17 and 18 October.
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM. NET FM’s own recurring weekend grid includes two sports programmes. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the weekly grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and does not confirm match commentary or carriage of a particular event.
records.notes: NET FM’s official programme grid: https://netfm.com.mt/. The frequency is from the Broadcasting Authority; the programme names/times are from the station. The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed. Re-checked 11 October: NET FM’s schedule page lists Friday 18:30 ‘Mhux Premier biss’, Saturday 16:00 ‘Hits & Score’ and Sunday 15:00 ‘Sports Box’ (grid times as published; time zone not stated). The Broadcasting Authority list checked 11 October shows NET FM at 101 MHz.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sportiva on Saturday and Sunday, 15:05–17:00. Its schedule page says programming may vary with the sporting events of the day. The date-specific live items shown when checked were for 5–11 October, not 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network’s Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station. Radio Sportiva’s own schedule lists weekend sports programming. The specific channel page is dated 2020 and gives no current technical reception details, so treat it as a plausible DAB+ option to scan for by station name, not as a reception test or a promise of live coverage of a named match.
records.notes: DAB+ channel list: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. The Broadcasting Authority identifies DigiB Network as the licensed digital-radio service provider: https://ba.org.mt/licence-applications. The provider’s site says DAB+ sets tune by service name: https://dab.com.mt/. Station’s official schedule and its note that programming can vary: https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/. The Radio Sportiva channel profile is dated 20 August 2020; no current block/frequency or on-location reception test was found. Times are as published; Italy and Malta share the same civil time during this trip.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC’s official Sportsworld upcoming-broadcasts page lists Saturday 17 October at 13:06 GMT and Sunday 18 October at 14:06 GMT on BBC World Service (except News Internet). That is 15:06 and 16:06 Malta time respectively (UTC+2).
records.description: The Malta DAB+ channel directory includes BBC World Service. The BBC’s dated programme listing schedules Sportsworld, described as live sport with news, interviews and analysis, on both playoff-weekend dates. The programme listing identifies the BBC World Service radio feed; a separate record gives WorldDAB’s DAB+ block/frequency listing. Neither directory evidence nor the programme schedule proves reception at the traveler’s locations or commentary on the trip’s esports, football, or sailing events.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ directory listing for BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Dated BBC programme pages: Saturday 17 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw ; Sunday 18 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313. The schedule labels the feed “BBC World Service except News Internet”; the episode page’s displayed local clock depends on the viewer’s time zone. Times above are converted from 13:06 and 14:06 GMT to 15:06 and 16:06 Malta time (UTC+2). WorldDAB’s technical listing and the reception caveat are recorded separately; no reception test at AX ODYCY or MFCC was available. Re-checked 11 October: the BBC’s upcoming-broadcasts list shows Sportsworld on BBC World Service except News Internet on Sat 17 October and Sun 18 October; the 17 October episode page carries an ‘On radio’ broadcast entry for the same service.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required for radio reception; hardware price not checked

records.description: WorldDAB lists BBC World Service on Malta’s Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz. This is technical-directory evidence for tuning/scanning, not a measured signal-strength result or a guarantee of reliable reception indoors at the hotel or event venue.
records.notes: WorldDAB’s Malta multiplex directory lists BBC WS on Digi B Network 6A (181.936 MHz). Digi B’s channel list separately includes BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Wohnort lists transmission sites at Għargħur and Żebbuġ (Gozo), but is a directory rather than an on-location reception test: https://www.wohnort.org/dab/malta.html. No receiver scan at AX ODYCY or the MFCC was available; actual reception remains unknown.

records.name: AM / medium wave — no current sports broadcast verified
records.hours: No current AM/MW sports schedule was verified for 13–19 October 2026.
records.description: No current AM or medium-wave sports station was confirmed in the sources checked. A 2026 TVM News history says Radju Malta began on 999 MW and changed to 93.7 FM in 1979; that historic 999 MW reference is not evidence of a current AM service.
records.notes: The current Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list was checked for current AM/MW sports carriage; it lists licensed FM and DAB services but no current AM sports schedule. Historical frequency context: https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/radju-malta-is-53-years-old/. The absence of a listing is not a guarantee that no distant AM signal can ever be received; do not rely on an AM sports programme without current station confirmation. Re-checked 11 October: both pages of the Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list show nationwide FM, DAB+ and community FM/DAB entries and no AM or medium-wave station.

records.name: NET FM — Friday 18:30 ‘Mhux Premier biss’ slot
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta (FM 101 MHz)
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring Friday grid lists 18:30 ‘Mhux Premier biss’ (time zone not stated). Friday 16 October 2026 is inside the trip window; the programme’s content for that date is not confirmed.
records.description: NET FM’s published Friday schedule includes an 18:30 programme titled ‘Mhux Premier biss’ (Maltese for roughly ‘not only the Premier’). The title suggests Premier League talk, but the format, presenters and whether it carries live match commentary were not verified. Treat it as a schedule lead only.
records.notes: Schedule from NET FM’s own grid, checked 11 October: https://netfm.com.mt/ . Frequency from the Broadcasting Authority: https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced . The grid is recurring, does not state a time zone and is not a dated 16 October 2026 programme listing. It is not a confirmed football commentary broadcast.

records.name: Premier League official live audio (app/web) — not over-the-air radio
records.area: Online or app; availability in Malta not checked
records.hours: The official Matchweek 7 Saturday page shows a ‘Listen live’ panel and says live streams require signing in to a Premier League account. A ‘Live Commentary will start at 08:30’ message appears on the page with no time zone; it was not confirmed as a fixture time.
records.price range: Account required; any charge or territory restriction not checked
records.description: The Premier League’s own Matchweek 7 blog page (checked 11 October) advertises live audio through a Premier League account. This is an internet audio stream. It does not meet the AM/FM/DAB+ requirement and is not evidence of over-the-air carriage in Malta.
records.notes: The fetch of this page showed an ad-blocker error inside an embedded widget, so the live-audio terms and availability in Malta remain unverified. The official 2026/27 matches page (checked 11 October; Matchweek 6 visible) shows ‘Watch Live On’ tags for USA Network, Universo, Peacock, NBC and Telemundo only in the visible portion: https://www.premierleague.com/en/matches/premier-league/2026-27 . No Malta or radio broadcaster appears in that visible portion.

records.name: Premier League fixtures on the trip weekend (17–19 Oct) — fixture list, not radio
records.area: England (Premier League); times converted to Malta time
records.hours: Guardian listings are in US Eastern time (EDT); Malta is 6 hours ahead of EDT on these dates. Sat 17 Oct: Everton v Chelsea 13:30; Brentford v Liverpool 16:00; Fulham v Hull City 16:00; Manchester City v Ipswich Town 16:00; Newcastle United v Aston Villa 18:30. Sun 18 Oct: AFC Bournemouth v Sunderland 15:00; Brighton & Hove Albion v Crystal Palace 15:00; Leeds United v Manchester United 15:00; Nottingham Forest v Arsenal 17:30. Mon 19 Oct: Tottenham Hotspur v Coventry City 21:00 (from a Guardian search snippet).
records.price range: Not applicable; no ticket or broadcast price checked
records.description: A secondary fixture list for the trip weekend, useful for choosing which Premier League matches to listen for. It does not show whether any match is broadcast on Maltese radio, and it is not an official Premier League fixture list.
records.notes: The Guardian’s 17 October page was read in full for Saturday; Sunday and Monday entries came from search-result snippets of the same listings, so confirm them. The official Premier League Matchweek 6 page (checked 11 October) showed the same 11–12 October times as the Guardian list in the same viewer time zone, which supports the EDT basis; the official Matchweek 7 fixture list did not load in this check: https://www.premierleague.com/en/matches/premier-league/2026-27 . Malta’s EU clocks change on 25 October and US clocks on 1 November 2026, so the 6-hour offset applies on 17–19 October. Confirm kick-off and postponement notices on premierleague.com before listening.

Use this only as a DAB+ scan lead and confirm the on-air service name before counting it: https://dab.com.mt/channels/ .
